added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own gate logs named in its manifest test_logs (head_arm.log at head a5195290a, base_arm.log at 786c5ba8): 0 failures at head minus 5 at base yields no added failing test. The reviewed run's manifest carries baseline_suite and after_suite as null (classification.json shows both null), so the count was derived from the named logs directly. The reviewer's own arms independently reproduce both: rv_head_gate.log 8 passed EXIT=0 at a5195290a, rv_base_gate.log 5 failed 3 passed EXIT=1 at 786c5ba8.

findings.text: The after-arm logs the fragment names (head_arm.log, head_regression.log) carry no revision/tree/command header, and head_arm.log carries no EXIT sentinel, while base_arm.log and the nc_*.log arms do carry a header. The head evidence is therefore not self-describing at the revision it claims. Carried from the prior review of this run (its follow-on 3) and still present at the reviewed head; the reviewer's own head gate (rv_head_gate.log) supplies the missing header and EXIT=0 for this delta.

test_the_patch_writer_refuses_when_the_stored_plan_cannot_be_read exercises only the read-error branch of _status_before_the_patch (read_plan raising). The two sibling branches that also return the empty string and hence fail closed — an empty project or slug, and an empty stored record (stored = {}) — are not separately exercised, so a future change to either is not fenced by this test.

item_verdicts.diff: read the two delta commits against 4de09c126e: 4fa2d6004 makes _status_before_the_patch return the empty string on an unreadable store (fail closed) and adds an on-disk grandfathering fixture plus a fail-closed test; a5195290a updates the evidence fragment to record both follow-ons, the two negative controls and the 8-test gate.
item_verdicts.done_when: the census is recorded with its count (17 of 213 terminal mounted plans hold an open section) and the two refusal tests must fail at base; head 8 passed EXIT=0, base arm 5 failed EXIT=1 with the refusal tests failing DID NOT RAISE.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to refuse a write that sets a plan to shipped or done while any declaration is implementable or deferred, naming the open sections; reproduced at head: apply_ops raises 'terminal status refused: 1 section(s) still open (s2)' for an implementable section, and the patch writer fails closed and raises the same naming when the stored plan cannot be read.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate (8 passed EXIT=0), the five-file patch-path regression (115 passed EXIT=0), the base and two nc arms, and the census count, all under test_logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the run's declared write paths; every path in the delta's two commits is inside them.

justifications.durability: the fail-closed fix is exercised by two negative controls (nc_requested: requested-status-only keying restored, the stored-terminal grandfathering test fails; nc_fallback: fallback-to-state-status restored, the unreadable-store test fails) and the production grandfathering case is now a real on-disk fixture rather than one with project/slug removed; docked because _status_before_the_patch's empty-project/slug and empty-record fail-closed branches are not separately exercised by a test.
justifications.evidence: the census is recorded with its count (census.log: 15 projects, 374 plans, 213 terminal, 17 terminal-with-open-section, all 17 slugs listed in the fragment) and the measure is an independent base/head pair: reviewer head gate 8 passed EXIT=0 at a5195290a and reviewer base arm 5 failed 3 passed EXIT=1 at 786c5ba8, reproducing the run's own head_arm.log (8 passed) and base_arm.log (5 failed, EXIT=1). Docked because the run's own head_arm.log and head_regression.log carry no revision/tree/command header and head_arm.log no EXIT sentinel, the manifest names its gate logs under test_logs rather than baseline_suite/after_suite, and the wider-regression base-arm comparison was stopped leaving 5 order-dependent failures unattributed.
justifications.fit: reuses the existing terminal-guard idiom (_require_every_section_ticked beside _refuse_hiding_followup at reckon/_store.py:3274) and the pre-existing _LANDED_STATUSES constant (:3132), and reads the stored-status technique _followups_before_the_patch already uses; no new module and no new write path.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_store.py:3308 (validate_landing_patch), :3428 (apply_ops) and :1345 (_write_state_locked) call _require_every_section_ticked on a write moving a plan into shipped or done, all three transition-keyed, and :3284 reads _plan_html.open_sections, so the landed change refuses the landing and names the open ids exactly as the goal states; the delta's fail-closed change means an unreadable store can no longer switch the guard off. Probe at head: validate_landing_patch on a plan whose stored record cannot be read raises 'terminal status refused: 1 section(s) still open (s2)'.
justifications.reuse: reads the single open-section predicate _plan_html.open_sections rather than re-deriving the declaration vocabulary, and reuses the stored-plan read (read_plan) rather than adding a parallel reader for the pre-write status.
justifications.scope_discipline: the delta's two commits change only reckon/_store.py, tests/test_terminal_status_needs_every_section_ticked.py and the evidence fragment, every one inside the run's declared write paths (reckon/_store.py, tests/test_terminal_status_needs_every_section_ticked.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-plan-is-done-when-every-section-is-ticked/a-plan-reaches-done-only-when-every-section-is-ticked.html).
